svg.title: Fixed-wing drone — Fastvængja dróni
svg.desc: A narrow unmanned aircraft has long straight wings, a rear pusher propeller and an angled V tail.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"aviation-fixed-wing-drone","label_en":"Fixed-wing drone","label_is":"Fastvængja dróni","section":"04","category_en":"Aircraft and flight","category_is":"Loftför og flug","batch":2,"tags":["aviation","drone"],"description":"A narrow unmanned aircraft has long straight wings, a rear pusher propeller and an angled V tail.","design_note":"The straight wing, pusher and V tail distinguish this drone from the conventional sailplane and canard aircraft.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
